# Codex 0.163.0 protocol fixtures

Generated by the official `codex-cli 0.163.0` binary with
`codex app-server generate-json-schema --out <directory>`. These are the
self-contained v1 initialization and v2 discovery/history schemas used by
the current compatibility tests. They validate the wire format; native TUI
execution is documented separately in the frontend compatibility report.
The startup Bedrock advisory response uses the same generator with
`--experimental`, because the stock TUI requests this experimental method.

Upstream: https://github.com/openai/codex/releases/tag/rust-v0.163.0
Protocol: https://learn.chatgpt.com/docs/app-server
